_meta.paper_freeze_anchor: 2026-08-10 (RBM-OT + Deferred RBM both NO-GO; method frozen = plain RBM)
_meta.scope_policy: Per-cell same-scope pair. If exact same-scope numerator+denominator unavailable, cell marked 'MISSING' or 'CROSS_SCOPE' in radar.
_meta.n_policy: Full-split where available; n200 paired where full-split not available; n500 where only HF baseline (j7hf) ran.
_meta.scorer: Official rescore via rescore_official.py for RBM/post-L2/none; r2b/r2c r2b_fastv_k3.md for FastV-k3; paired_metric_statistics.md for recomputed margins.
_meta.engine: vLLM for throughput (panel d); native HF eager for OCRBench paired (panel c); mixed for radar (panel a/b).

panel_a_qwen3vl_retention_25pct.description: Qwen3-VL-8B performance retention at 25% visual-token retention (r=0.75 keep). 4 axes: OCRBench, TextVQA, DocVQA, GQA. 3 methods: RBM, FastV-k3, Post-merger L2. Each value = 100 * compressed / uncompressed on the exact same sample scope. Mixed scope per cell, see scope field.

none.source: giant-image OOM on full-split; n200 n/a in main JSON

retention_pct_notes.DocVQA: none full-split score not on disk (giant-image OOM). Plot as dagger/hollow marker; do not silently substitute. n200 n/a for none.
retention_pct_notes.OCRBench_FastV_k3: n200 numerator over full-split denominator — cross-scope, but the n200 subset is a random sample of the 1000 full-split so the estimate is informative; show value but flag with footnote.
retention_pct_notes.RBM_DocVQA: partial 5349 (full-split native). RBM at 0.481 (native, partial) implies retention ~49% of an estimated full-split none (~0.97). Marker as dagger.

panel_b_qwen25vl_retention_25pct.description: Qwen2.5-VL-7B performance retention at 25% visual-token retention (r=0.75 keep). PAIRED n200 same-scope (none, RBM, FastV-k3, post-L2 on identical subset). Exact-scope comparison.
panel_b_qwen25vl_retention_25pct.scope_label: paired n200 (same skip set across all 4 methods)

stat_inconclusive_marker.DocVQA_RBM_vs_FastV_k3: RBM 51.93 vs FastV 49.77, diff 2.16 pp, within n200 noise — hollow marker per spec
stat_inconclusive_marker.GQA_RBM_vs_FastV_k3: RBM 88.89 vs FastV 81.20, diff 7.69 pp, larger but Qwen2.5 GQA n200 paired has known high variance — dagger if outside CI
stat_inconclusive_marker.OCRBench_RBM_vs_FastV_k3: RBM 45.96 vs FastV 35.40, diff 10.56 pp — firm RBM win (the 8.5 pp claim is conservative, recompute +9.44 pp on native n200 HF)

panel_c_ocr_pareto.description: OCRBench accuracy vs mean visual tokens sent to LLM at 25% retention. Two models (Qwen3-VL circle, Qwen2.5-VL square). Methods: none, RBM, FastV-k3, post-L2. Guide lines connect same-model points. Annotated RBM-vs-FastV margins: Qwen3 +16.0 pp (paper claim, recompute +17.68 pp), Qwen2.5 +8.5 pp (paper claim, recompute +9.44 pp).
panel_c_ocr_pareto.scope: Paired n200 native HF for RBM/FastV; j2/vLLM n200 crossarch for none/post-L2 (Qwen2.5); full vLLM 1000 for Qwen3 none/post-L2. NOTE: scope differs across methods for Qwen2.5 — see provenance.
panel_c_ocr_pareto.x_axis: mean visual tokens sent to LLM (ptid_len)
panel_c_ocr_pareto.y_axis: OCRBench official score / 1.0 (0-1 range; annotate as 0-100%)

scientific_headline: RBM preserves the OCR regime under aggressive compression while delivering the standard token-reduction speedup; query-conditioned FastV remains stronger on reference/object-grounded workloads.

panel_titles.c: OCR regime: accuracy vs visual tokens
